title: Title IX - education discrimination basics
facts: Title IX prohibits discrimination on the basis of sex in education programs or activities receiving federal financial assistance, subject to the statute and applicable regulations.
Title IX can apply to areas including admissions in covered contexts, athletics, pregnancy-related protections, sexual harassment and other sex-based discrimination.
The U.S. Department of Education Office for Civil Rights enforces Title IX for covered education institutions.
Current Title IX regulatory requirements can change through rulemaking and court decisions, so procedural questions should be checked against current Department of Education guidance.
